data.title: New Device High-Value Transaction
data.description: Detects a high-value financial transaction initiated from a new or previously unknown device shortly after initial authentication. Attackers who have compromised credentials and bypassed MFA via SIM swap typically move quickly to execute high-value transfers from a device with no prior history on the account, exploiting the narrow window before the victim notices.

enrichment_required.source: Device profiling enrichment (first-seen date from device intelligence)
Device profiling enrichment (trust score from device intelligence platform)
Session analytics enrichment (minutes since last authentication)

falsepositives: Customers logging in from a newly purchased device to make a planned large payment
Joint account holders using a device not previously associated with the account
